'never') is false or (jsonb_typeof("business_foundation_entry"."payload"->'never') = 'string' and char_length("business_foundation_entry"."payload"->>'never') between 1 and 2000)) and (("business_foundation_entry"."payload" ? 'remember') is false or (jsonb_typeof("business_foundation_entry"."payload"->'remember') = 'string' and char_length("business_foundation_entry"."payload"->>'remember') between 1 and 2000)) and (("business_foundation_entry"."payload" ? 'name') is false or (jsonb_typeof("business_foundation_entry"."payload"->'name') = 'string' and char_length("business_foundation_entry"."payload"->>'name') between 1 and 60)) and (("business_foundation_entry"."payload" ?
